title: Topic 6.5: Trade and Finance in Islam

pages.lesson:
LESSON: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.5: Trade and Finance in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Trade and Finance in Islam. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Trade and Finance in Islam
2. Practise Trade and Finance in Islam at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Trade and Finance in Islam

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Trade and Finance in Islam
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Trade and Finance in Islam. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Trade and Finance in Islam at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Trade and Finance in Islam at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Trade and Finance in Islam
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Trade and Finance in Islam. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Trade and Finance in Islam using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Trade and Finance in Islam in the examples.
2. Explain Trade and Finance in Islam to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Trade and Finance in Islam.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Trade and Finance in Islam using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Trade and Finance in Islam important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Trade and Finance in Islam
2. Practise Trade and Finance in Islam at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Trade and Finance in Islam

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
